scripts.build: mkdir -p webroot && rm -f webroot/mygame.null0 && docker run --rm --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v ./cart:/src -v ./webroot:/out ghcr.io/notnullgames/null0-cart-wren:latest mygame
scripts.build:watch: npx -y nodemon -e wren,png,json,wav,ogg,tmx,tsx --watch cart --exec 'npm run build'
scripts.start: npm run build && npx -y npm-run-all -p web build:watch
